# Welcome to the Lab Wiki {.unnumbered}

This wiki is a shared, practical reference for people working in [**The (UN)Adaptive Mind Lab**](https://sites.google.com/site/irenecogliatidezza/team). It brings together onboarding information, everyday lab procedures, and methods guidance in one place.

The source is organized as small Markdown-based chapters. You can edit the relevant chapter directly on GitHub; the published site is rebuilt automatically when the change reaches the `main` branch.

## How to use this wiki {.unnumbered}

- Use the searchable contents in the sidebar to find a topic.
- Treat time-sensitive or institution-specific details as items to verify before acting.
- If something is missing or unclear, add a note to the relevant chapter or contact **Lingyu** (lingyu.meng\@ulb.be).
- Do not put passwords, personal data, confidential participant information, or restricted internal documents in this folder.

## Contributing {.unnumbered}

Open the chapter you want to update in the GitHub repository, select **Edit this file**, and commit your Markdown changes or submit a pull request. GitHub Actions rebuilds the full book after changes reach `main`. See [README.md](README.md) for instructions on adding chapters and setting up the site. [Here](https://github.com/Lingyu-Meng/Lab_wiki) is the repository of this wiki.
